description: This PHP file defines the LeadFeed class, which extends FeedLogicBase. The class is responsible for creating and pushing activity feed notifications related to lead creation and conversion events within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM system. It includes logic to format and send different feed messages depending on the lead's state.

classes.name: LeadFeed
classes.description: A class that manages activity feed notifications for lead creation and conversion events, extending the FeedLogicBase class.

methods.name: pushFeed
methods.description: Creates a notification message when a lead is created or converted and pushes it to the activity feed.
